describes: packages/plugin/measurement: page scale from the engine viewports or the default, scale writes and re-measurement, units, precision and presets, the calibration flow, readouts and measurement creation, run beside the real interaction and annotation plugins.

cases.name: reads-without-a-measure-service
cases.covers: Without an engine measure service every page loads at once onto the metric default (1:1 in metres, not persistent). The reads: the scale (a page not in the document reads the loading scale), the twins, the busy flag, the last reports, the presets, the units and the area units, the pending request. measureDistance and measureArea convert page points through the page geometry and read the page scale; a page not in the document throws not-found. getReadout reads a dimension annotation and answers not-dimension for an unknown ref. ensureLoaded resolves at once for a loaded page and rejects not-found for a page not in the document.

cases.name: imperial-default-and-custom-presets
cases.covers: defaultScale 'imperial' makes the fallback 1:1 in feet, and presets replaces the picker.

cases.name: custom-default-measure
cases.covers: A PdfMeasure as defaultScale is the fallback as it is, whatever the page userUnit; setPreset scales the ratio by the page userUnit.

cases.name: measure-service-viewports
cases.covers: With the engine's measure service each page reads its viewports. An owned viewport wins wherever it is; otherwise the viewport under the crop's centre (the last containing one) is a foreign scale, one without a measure reads null, and a page whose viewports miss the centre falls back to the default. Every page is persistent. canMeasure is ready on each; a foreign scale gives readouts of foreign-measure.

cases.name: viewport-reads-fail-refresh-and-rehydrate
cases.covers: A refused viewport read leaves the page not ready with the serialized error; ensureLoaded retries it. A page.viewportsChanged event re-reads that page (one not in the document is refused quietly), stream.desynced and document.versioned re-read every page, and any other event is ignored. While a read is in flight the page reads not ready with its previous scale.

cases.name: refresh-epochs
cases.covers: Viewport reads carry an epoch per page: an older read that answers after a newer one began is dropped, whether it resolves or rejects, and ensureLoaded joins the read in flight rather than starting another.

cases.name: set-scale-on-one-page
cases.covers: Without a measure service setScale publishes an owned 'EmbedPDF' viewport over the crop, keeping foreign ones, re-measures the page's dimensions through the annotation plugin and announces the change; isBusy is true while it runs and listLastReports keeps the reports. recalculate false skips the re-measure and reports the scale alone. clearScale drops the owned viewport and re-measures with the default. A single-page change rejects: a measure that is not writable, and a page not in the document.

cases.name: set-scale-on-several-pages
cases.covers: 'all' and a list of pages change each page and report per page: a page that fails (not in the document, a measure that is not writable, a scale without a rectilinear base) reports scaleError instead of rejecting. A list of one page is still strict.

cases.name: units-precision-and-presets
cases.covers: setUnit, setAreaUnit and setPrecision edit the page's rectilinear scale (the default counts) and write it back; a fractional last format restarts at a precision of 100. An invalid precision, a base unit that is not a length unit, and an unknown preset reject; setPreset writes the preset's ratio.

cases.name: service-writes-and-foreign-scales
cases.covers: With a measure service a scale write goes to the engine, then the page re-reads its viewports. A refused engine write rejects a single-page change, and the next change on that page still runs. Unit and precision edits need a rectilinear scale: a foreign one, or a viewport without a measure, rejects not-ready. Two changes on one page queue behind each other.

cases.name: calibration-flow
cases.covers: startCalibration clears any request and arms the calibrate tool. The tool's captured line becomes the pending request in page space (the pointer tool comes back, onCalibrationRequested fires); calibrate derives the scale from the known length, writes it, clears the request for its page and fires onCalibrationCompleted. A request on another page survives a calibrate elsewhere; dismissCalibration drops it and fires onCalibrationDismissed, and is silent with nothing pending. applyTo widens the write. Two identical points reject invalid-input; a page not in the document rejects not-found. A capture tool other than calibrate is ignored.

cases.name: zero-length-capture
cases.covers: A calibrate tool configured to click-create a zero-length line captures it, and a zero-length capture makes no request.

cases.name: without-authority
cases.covers: Read-only: canCalibrate and canMeasure are false, every scale change rejects permission-denied before touching a page, startCalibration does nothing, and createMeasurement rejects permission-denied.

cases.name: create-measurement
cases.covers: createMeasurement creates a line (distance), a polyline (perimeter) or a polygon (area) through the annotation plugin, with the kind's own tool unless one is named. A distance needs exactly two points; a page whose scale is not known rejects not-ready.

cases.name: listener-throws
cases.covers: A throwing listener goes to console.error('[measurement] listener failed:', error); the change still resolves. An unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

cases.name: pages-inserted-and-removed
cases.covers: A page inserted after the plugin connected loads its viewports; a structural event that keeps the same pages loads nothing. A page removed while its viewport read is in flight is not published, and a later change on it rejects not-found.

cases.name: page-removed-while-a-change-waits
cases.covers: Without a measure service, a preset change queued behind another on the same page finds the page gone once it runs: the ratio falls back to a userUnit of 1 and the write rejects not-found.

cases.name: close-mid-flight
cases.covers: Closing the document while changes run: a single-page change rejects with the engine call's instance-closed, a multi-page change whose pages all reported rejects not-ready (the plugin is disposed), neither touches the busy counter again, and a viewport read in flight is not published.
